crmDomain.description: The address you open Freshsales on, without https://. For example yourcompany.myfreshworks.com, yourcompany.freshsales.io or crm.yourcompany.com.

regex.domain-format-error: Enter only the domain, for example yourcompany.myfreshworks.com

crmApiKey.description: In Freshsales, open your profile picture > Settings > API settings and copy the API key. Exports see what this user can see.
